name: nem
description: Australia's National Electricity Market as the dashboard reads it: what each unit generated, what each region paid, what flowed between regions, and what wind and solar were curtailed.

This file is the semantic model: the datasets, how they relate, and the measures. compiler.js turns it into DuckDB views (one per dataset and per relationship) and macros (one per function and metric). The page then queries those in SQL, written by hand.
In an expression, {name} is one of the constants below.

A dataset only holds what is attached. The 5-minute datasets hold the last 5 days (v_interconnector 14) until the half-year files of a date range are attached; the daily ones hold the last 14 days, and the hourly ones do not exist, until the daily aggregate is. A query over the rest runs and returns the newest days alone, with no error: the compiler's needs(sql) says what a query reads.
A fact dataset stays readable as it is: a query that needs nothing about the unit reads it, not the relationship's view, and pays for no join.

recent_days.description: Rows from this many days back are read from `today` (refreshed every 30 minutes), older ones from the half-year history files or the daily aggregate. CURRENT_DATE is the NEM's day: the host sets the session to Brisbane time for it.

unregistered.description: The fuel of a unit that is in the data and not in dim_duid, e.g. one the registration list hasn't caught up with yet. Its rows are kept, so it still counts toward totals. A unit that is in dim_duid without a fuel is 'Unknown'.

rooftop.description: The fuel of the rooftop pseudo-units (QLD_PV, NSW_PV, VIC_PV, SA_PV, TAS_PV): AEMO's regional estimate, one unit per region, with no capacity and no coordinates. The estimate is half-hourly, drawn as a straight line onto the 5-minute intervals (scripts/cache_catalog.py rooftop_units).

storage_fuel.description: The fuel of batteries. Storage is on neither side of the renewable share.

glossary.time: HHMM as a number, NEM time: 1435 is 14:35, and the hour is time // 100.
glossary.mw: MW in that 5 minutes; a battery charging is negative. Energy in MWh is SUM(mw) / 12. An interval at 0 MW is not stored, so AVG(mw) and COUNT(*) only see the others: the intervals of a range are counted in v_price.
glossary.mwh: Energy. Daily: the day's, net of charging. Hourly: that hour of the day over the month, output only (charging is left out).
glossary.hour: Hour of day, 0-23. The average MW at an hour over a range is SUM(mwh) / SUM(v_month_days.days) over its months.
glossary.price: The regional reference price (AEMO's RRP), $/MWh. In the daily and hourly datasets, the plain average of the intervals.
glossary.demand: Operational demand in MW: rooftop solar is not in it. Daily: the average MW.
glossary.demand_mwh: The day's operational demand as energy: a whole day from the aggregate, the intervals so far today.
glossary.net_interchange: MW, positive when the region exports.
glossary.region: NSW1, QLD1, SA1, TAS1, VIC1. v_unit also holds the units of WA1 (Western Australia, another market), which v_region leaves out.
glossary.REGIONID: The region, under AEMO's name for the column: NSW1, QLD1, SA1, TAS1, VIC1.
glossary.DUID: AEMO's id of a dispatchable unit.

stitching.cut: History before the cut (constants.recent_days), recent from the cut on. The default.
stitching.cut_when_history: The same once the history is attached; until then the recent table as it is, all its days.
stitching.after_history: History before the cut, and from recent whatever is newer than the attached history holds: a file without the table, or a daily import that is behind, leaves no hole.

datasets.name: v_duid
datasets.description: dim_duid under the names the export gives its columns: the units on AEMO's registration list plus the ones in the data that are not on it (retired plant, replaced DUIDs), and the rooftop pseudo-units. Queries read v_unit.

datasets.name: v_calendar
datasets.description: dim_calendar. The first date is where the history starts.

datasets.name: v_scada_today
datasets.description: Generation per unit and 5 minutes, the newest 14 days: where the latest interval is read.

datasets.name: v_price_today
datasets.description: Price and demand per region and 5 minutes, the newest 14 days, with the region's semi-scheduled wind and solar.

fields.name: wind_available
fields.description: MW the region's semi-scheduled wind could make.

fields.name: wind_curtailed
fields.description: MW of it that was not dispatched.

fields.name: solar_available
fields.description: MW the region's semi-scheduled solar could make.

fields.name: solar_curtailed
fields.description: MW of it that was not dispatched.

datasets.name: v_price
datasets.description: Price and demand per region and 5 minutes.

datasets.name: v_price_daily
datasets.description: Price and demand per region and day. A day from `today` with any interval missing demand (fct_regionsum_today still filling) keeps demand NULL.

fields.name: demand
fields.rollup: CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(demand) = COUNT(*) THEN AVG(demand) END AS REAL)

fields.name: net_interchange
fields.rollup: CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(net_interchange) = COUNT(*) THEN AVG(net_interchange) END AS REAL)

fields.name: demand_mwh
fields.rollup: CASE WHEN COUNT(demand) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(demand) / 12.0 END

datasets.name: v_interconnector
datasets.description: Flow on each link between regions, per 5 minutes, back to 2018. mw is the dispatch target, positive from the first region in the name to the second (T-V-MNSP1 > 0: Tasmania to Victoria); export_limit and import_limit bound it, in the same sign. History files built before 2026-10-03 have no such table.

datasets.name: v_scada_hourly
datasets.description: Energy per unit, month and hour of day: what the daily profile reads for ranges over 30 days. It leaves out the newest date of the export.

datasets.name: v_price_hourly
datasets.description: Price per region, month and hour of day: what the price heatmap reads for ranges over 30 days.

datasets.name: v_month_days
datasets.description: The days of each month that have data: the divisor of the hourly datasets.

datasets.name: v_curtailment_daily
datasets.description: Curtailment per semi-scheduled unit and day, up to the newest complete next-day file.

fields.name: available_mwh
fields.description: What the unit could have made.

datasets.name: v_unit
datasets.description: A unit and its attributes, under the names the page uses. One row per unit.

fields.name: fuel_source
fields.description: The fuel as registered; may be NULL.

fields.name: renewable
fields.description: As dim_duid says: the list of renewable fuels is in the dbt model, and the rooftop units get it in the export.

calculated.name: generator
calculated.description: Anything that is not storage. Its own column, for speed (EXPLAIN, 2026-10-04): the charts that leave storage out filter on it, not on NOT storage. With the fuel filter on Grid the optimizer then sees fuel = 'Grid' AND fuel <> 'Grid' and reads nothing; it does not see through NOT (fuel = 'Grid'). That is why storage is a rule on the fuel here and not a column of dim_duid like renewable: a rule written as an IN list in a view runs as a hash join in every query, read or not.

datasets.name: v_region
datasets.sql: SELECT DISTINCT Region AS region FROM v_duid WHERE Region IS NOT NULL AND Region != 'WA1'

datasets.name: v_gen_latest
datasets.description: v_gen_today, the newest interval only. The interval is found in v_scada_today, not in the joined view.
sql: SELECT * FROM v_gen_today WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_scada_today)
AND time = (SELECT MAX(time) FROM v_scada_today WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_scada_today))

datasets.name: v_price_latest
sql: SELECT * FROM v_price_today WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_price_today)
AND time = (SELECT MAX(time) FROM v_price_today WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_price_today))

datasets.name: v_curtailment_recent
datasets.description: Curtailment for the days after v_curtailment_daily's newest, per region and fuel, from AEMO's regional 5-minute figures in `today`: the same two measures. No unit, so no DUID.
sql: SELECT REGIONID AS region, date, 'Wind' AS fuel,
SUM(wind_curtailed) / 12.0 AS curtailed_mwh, SUM(wind_available) / 12.0 AS available_mwh
FROM v_price_today WHERE date > (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_curtailment_daily) GROUP BY ALL
SELECT REGIONID AS region, date, 'Solar' AS fuel,
SUM(solar_curtailed) / 12.0 AS curtailed_mwh, SUM(solar_available) / 12.0 AS available_mwh
FROM v_price_today WHERE date > (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_curtailment_daily) GROUP BY ALL

relationships.name: v_gen
relationships.description: Generation per unit and 5 minutes, with the unit's attributes on every row. A unit missing from v_unit keeps its rows, under the fuel constants.unregistered names.

relationships.name: v_gen_daily
relationships.description: Energy per unit and day, with the unit's attributes.

relationships.name: v_gen_hourly
relationships.description: Energy per unit, month and hour of day, with the unit's attributes.

relationships.name: v_curtailment
relationships.description: Curtailment per wind or solar farm and day, with the unit's attributes.

relationships.name: v_gen_price
relationships.description: v_gen plus the price of the unit's region in that interval. A row without a price is kept: capture price and the battery chart add price IS NOT NULL.

relationships.name: v_gen_price_daily
relationships.description: v_gen_daily plus the day's price of the unit's region.

functions.name: fuel_name
functions.expression: CASE WHEN duid IS NULL THEN '{unregistered}' ELSE COALESCE(descr, 'Unknown') END
functions.description: The name a unit's fuel goes by on the page. The model's own: it names v_unit.fuel.

functions.name: generated
functions.description: Output only: a unit that is charging (negative) generates nothing. Given a daily mwh it clips the day's net: a battery counts for its output less its charging, never below 0.

metrics.name: renewable_share
expression: 100 * SUM(CASE WHEN renewable THEN generated(v) WHEN NOT renewable THEN 0 END)
/ NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN generator THEN generated(v) ELSE 0 END), 0)
metrics.description: Renewable share of the output. Takes the raw mw or mwh and the renewable and generator columns; batteries are in neither the renewables nor the total. A unit missing from dim_duid (renewable NULL) is in the total only. NULL, not 0, when nothing says what is renewable: a dim_duid deployed before the column existed.

metrics.name: capture_price
metrics.description: The price a volume earned: the prices weighted by it. Takes generated(mw) or generated(mwh), over v_gen_price or v_gen_price_daily with price IS NOT NULL: the join there is LEFT, and a volume without a price would count below the line only.

metrics.name: capacity_factor
metrics.description: Energy over what the registered capacity could make in the hours. Takes one row per unit (its energy in the range, its cap_mw once) and the hours of the range; a unit without a capacity (cap_mw NULL or 0, the rooftop ones) is filtered out first, or its energy counts against no capacity. NULL when the range has no hours.
